sum: Jasper Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical stage biotechnology company, focuses on the design and development of therapies to treat immune-mediated diseases. Its products in various stages of development include KP-104, a dual-complement inhibitor for the treatment of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) which is in Phase 2; Briquilimab is an anti-KIT antibody, which has demonstrated clinical results as a conditioning agent for stem cell transplant and mast cell mediated diseases, such as chronic urticarias and allergic asthma; and KP-701, a novel, dual-acting anti-CD79BxCD32B monoclonal antibody (mAb) for autoantibody-mediated disorders. The company is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
ceo: Mr. Jeetinder Singh Mahal M.B.A. (President, CEO, Interim CFO & Director)
